messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — proposal: push the Prompt Store (JIT retrieval + dynamic rewrites) to v1 and keep Offline tuning + Prompt Library for MVP. Need a decision by EOD so I can update the milestone tracker.

Rohit (Eng): What's the main engineering lift? JIT store is ~3 sprints of infra + runtime work (KV invalidation, strong consistency, eviction rules).

Elena (Design): UX impact? We can ship a lightweight Prompt Library editor for MVP and postpone the in-context rewrite flows to v1.

Sam (Data): Tradeoffs: without JIT we lose some token savings and live adaptation signal. We should measure prompt reuse rate and token reduction potential before final cut.

Jared (Sales): Pilot customers have asked for JIT to reduce spend. Are any of them blockers for the MVP ship?

Maya (PM): Not blockers — Pilot A is OK with static sets; Pilot B prefers JIT but can be put on 'early access' in v1.

Rohit (Eng): If we delay JIT we can reallocate 2 backend engineers to improve batching and caching heuristics now — that should reduce per-token cost faster.

Elena (Design): That sounds fine. We can scope a small copy-first Prompt Library (editor + tagging) as a quick win for adoption.

Sam (Data): I'll spin up an eval harness comparing static prompt sets vs JIT for the pilot prompts. First pass in ~2 weeks.

deploy-bot: Milestone update detected: MVP feature-list proposal posted by Maya — https://redwood/roadmap/PR-512

Maya (PM): Proposed milestone action list:
```text
- Remove: JIT Prompt Store (moved to v1)
- Keep: Prompt Library UI, Offline tuning pipeline
- Invest: Batching improvements, KV cache enhancements
- Decision deadline: EOD today
```

Rohit (Eng): Risk note: delaying JIT reduces our live-quality adaptation ability. I'll file a tech-debt ticket and link to the milestone.

Maya (PM): Agreed. I'll create the tech-debt ticket and flag it in the tracker. If no objections by EOD I'll update the tracker and inform legal/sales.

Jared (Sales): Please mark Pilot B as 'opt-in early access' and notify them about the timeline.

Elena (Design): Can we include usage examples and a simple onboarding flow in the Prompt Library copy? Quick UX win for pilots.

Sam (Data): I'll prioritize the eval tests and surface results in 10 business days.

Maya (PM): Sounds good — no objections here. I'll cut the MVP scope accordingly and update the sprint planning doc.
